name: Cantabrian people (Lábaru, Spain)
description: A purple (púrpura) field charged at the centre with a golden lábaru — a four-armed curved emblem derived from the Cantabrian stelae.
history: The lábaru is an unofficial identity flag of Cantabria, based on the swirling motif of the pre-Roman Cantabrian stelae; it is flown alongside the official regional flag.
